<!-- Generated by `go run ./internal/tools/docgen` from internal/crowdsecprofile/profiles.yaml. Do not edit. -->

Tested against CrowdSec `v1.8.1` (`crowdsecurity/crowdsec:v1.8.1@sha256:0f2523fa61ef507f15d953045cface490cc880670c62f2755ced17524107f71a`).

```yaml
# rán example CrowdSec profile. Put it in /etc/crowdsec/profiles.yaml, before any
# generic profile, or print the one matching your binary with `ran crowdsec-profile`.
# scan: one IP probing many protocols
name: ran_scan
filters:
  - Alert.GetScenario() startsWith "custom/ran-" && Alert.Events[0].GetMeta("class") == "scan"
decisions:
  - type: ban
    scope: Ip
    duration: 1h
duration_expr: "Sprintf('%.0fh', min(168.0, 3 ^ GetDecisionsCount(Alert.GetValue())))"
on_success: break
---
# attack: credentials, commands or payloads
name: ran_attack
filters:
  - Alert.GetScenario() startsWith "custom/ran-" && Alert.Events[0].GetMeta("class") == "attack"
decisions:
  - type: ban
    scope: Ip
    duration: 1h
duration_expr: "Sprintf('%.0fh', min(168.0, 3 ^ GetDecisionsCount(Alert.GetValue())))"
on_success: break
---
# any other ran alert (for example probe): no decision, and stop here so a later
# generic profile (for example a catch-all ban) cannot ban it
name: ran_noban
filters:
  - Alert.GetScenario() startsWith "custom/ran-"
on_success: break
```
